commands.name: dm
commands.title: List direct messages
commands.description: Gets the list of all direct message channels.

options.name: bot
options.label: Bot token (deprecated)
options.description: This option doesn't do anything. Kept for backwards compatibility.

options.name: respect-rate-limits
options.label: Respect advisory rate limits
options.description: Whether to respect advisory rate limits. If disabled, only hard rate limits (i.e., 429 responses) will be respected.

options.name: channel
options.label: Channel IDs
options.description: Channel ID(s). If provided with category ID(s), all channels inside those categories will be exported.
options.placeholder: Paste channel IDs separated by space, comma or newline

options.name: output
options.label: Output path
options.description: Output file or directory path. If a directory is specified, file names will be generated automatically based on the channel names and export parameters. Directory paths must end with a slash to avoid ambiguity. Supports template tokens, see the documentation for more info.

options.name: format
options.label: Export format
options.description: Export format.

options.name: after
options.label: After
options.description: Only include messages sent after this date or message ID.

options.name: before
options.label: Before
options.description: Only include messages sent before this date or message ID.

options.name: partition
options.label: Partition limit
options.description: Split the output into partitions, each limited to the specified number of messages (e.g., '100') or file size (e.g., '10mb').

options.name: include-threads
options.label: Include threads
options.description: Which types of threads should be included.

options.name: filter
options.label: Message filter
options.description: Only include messages that satisfy this filter. See the documentation for more info.

options.name: parallel
options.label: Parallel limit
options.description: Limits how many channels can be exported in parallel.

options.name: reverse
options.label: Newest messages first
options.description: Export messages in reverse chronological order (newest first).

options.name: markdown
options.label: Format markdown, mentions and emojis
options.description: Process markdown, mentions, and other special tokens.

options.name: media
options.label: Download media (avatars, files, images)
options.description: Download assets referenced by the export (user avatars, attached files, embedded images, etc.).

options.name: reuse-media
options.label: Reuse previously downloaded media
options.description: Reuse previously downloaded assets to avoid redundant requests.

options.name: media-dir
options.label: Media directory
options.description: Download assets to this directory. If not specified, the asset directory path will be derived from the output path.

options.name: dateformat
options.label: Date format (deprecated)
options.description: This option doesn't do anything. Kept for backwards compatibility.

options.name: locale
options.label: Locale
options.description: Locale to use when formatting dates and numbers. If not specified, the default system locale will be used.

options.name: utc
options.label: Normalize timestamps to UTC
options.description: Normalize all timestamps to UTC+0.

options.name: fuck-russia
options.label: Hide the Ukraine support message
options.description: Don't print the Support Ukraine message to the console.
